levels.name: Endless Keep
levels.subtitle: Survive as many waves as you can.
levels.briefing: The knights never stop coming. Dig in, build every room, train your monsters and see how many waves you can survive.

tutorial.text: Welcome, Keeper! There is no final level — survive as many waves as you can. The first tidy patrol arrives soon. Dig out some floor and start building!
Nice digging — the floor is yours now. Pick Rooms, choose Treasury, and paint a few tiles so your gold has somewhere to live.
Treasury, Lair, Hatchery, Training, Library and Workshop are all available. Build them all and train your creatures — every fifth wave brings Baron Bumblefrost.
Here they come! Each wave is bigger and tougher than the last. The goal is to reach the highest wave you can before the Dungeon Heart falls.
